details:
I am not really worried about how to raise rank but am more focus on how to prevent persistent malicious players from increasing in rank. Just some ideas I'm throwing around.

"the best way to raise your Rank is simply to play VRChat???spending time exploring, making friends..."

Play time should not have a direct correlation to trust. I mean even I, a casual player, have over 800 hours from the 8-9 months I played.

Trust for exploring worlds is a great incentive to get players to... explore more. Most of the trust gain in this area should be focused on public worlds. It makes no sense that trust increase by merely hiding in private worlds alone or with a close group of friends. Only by being in the open community would trust increase. Or decrease if blocked or voted to kick 'often'.

Making friends... I actually think that increase in trust by making friends can actually be a negative influence. More friends can mean greater popularity (and therefore trust), but some players will friend others because 'why not.' I try to limit my friends to people who I would interact with at least once in a while; not those that I just add and forget.

My opinion in short:
Long hours played in public maps should be one of the main methods to increase one's trust; with diminishing returns or greater requirements for higher ranks. Being blocked or voted to be kicked would increasingly damage trust when it starts to stack up. Minimal blocks/kicks over a long period of time would be negligible because... well some players block others for no reason. Maybe it's a hobby?
title: Fleeting Thoughts on Trust System
